texts.en:
A sense of wellbeing can already be felt throughout the [root.GetName] as pilgrims gather at their chosen places of worship. Sometimes they make offerings; many take advantage of the myriad stalls and street sellers which serve our holy sites.

Various rituals have been observed and invested in this cycle's [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession was festooned with garlands of various kinds. The principal Death Priest at [capital_scope.GetName] led an inspiring sermon, promising productive and comfortable times for all.

At the sermon's close, each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber to meet their end, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

summary.text:
# 祭献已毕：[root.GetName]财源广进 / A Sacrifice Made: Bounty for the [root.GetName]

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Necroids · 来源 Sources：`events/necroids_events_2.txt:148-215`、`common/edicts/03_sacrifices.txt:260-448`、`common/scripted_effects/00_scripted_effects.txt:5239` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

死亡教团（civic_death_cult / civic_death_cult_corporate）的灵性国家颁布祭献法令“祭献：财源广进”（edict sacrifice_bounty / sacrifice_bounty_zombie，common/edicts/03_sacrifices.txt:260-448）后，法令的效果立即发出 necroids.202。事件要求 is_spiritualist 且拥有死亡教团国民理念。两条法令都发出它（普通版与“永身雇佣制”僵尸版）。修正：矿物与能量产出各+5%，增长+5%。

A spiritualist empire with the Death Cult civic (civic_death_cult / civic_death_cult_corporate) enacts the sacrifice edict "Sacrifice: Bounty" (sacrifice_bounty / sacrifice_bounty_zombie, common/edicts/03_sacrifices.txt:260-448); the edict effect then fires necroids.202 at once. The event needs is_spiritualist and the Death Cult civic. Both the normal and the zombie (Permanent Employment) edicts fire it. Edict modifier: +5% minerals and energy, +5% growth.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

立即效果 death_cult_sacrifice_effect（00_scripted_effects.txt:5239）按祭献的初学者人数计算本次结果倍率 sacrifice_result_mult。唯一选项“赞美”：把对应的祭献修正加入国家1800天，强度乘以该倍率；若倍率≥0.05，还加上“死亡祭司”修正1800天。事件之后，在 recent_overlord_sacrifice 旗标下的附庸会得到宗主祭献修正并收到一条消息。

The immediate death_cult_sacrifice_effect (00_scripted_effects.txt:5239) computes the result multiplier sacrifice_result_mult from the number of sacrificed initiates. The only option, Praise, adds the matching sacrifice modifier for 1800 days scaled by that multiplier, and, if the multiplier is at least 0.05, also adds the Death Priest modifier for 1800 days. Afterwards subjects with recent_overlord_sacrifice get the overlord version of the modifier and a message.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支。三种祭献法令互斥（togetherness / harmony / bounty），见相邻故事 event-necroids-200/201/202。

No branches. The three sacrifice edicts are mutually exclusive (togetherness / harmony / bounty); see the sibling stories event-necroids-200/201/202.

The wording uses the empire adjective ([root.GetAdj]).
